The brain runs HOT by the captain's standing order (12 Jul 2026, with Nidhi): exhaust the Claude Max 5x plan every rolling window and every week; weight the heavy work overnight; protect his study hours; never touch an API key. brain.mjs is the sole reader; edits here are canon edits.
_paused_note: PAUSED by the captain 2 Aug 2026 — all 23 LLM jobs held. WHY: the rolling 7d window stood at 85,16,836 / 1,20,00,000 (71%) with headroom 0, and a measurement of that week showed the shape of the spend: 178 calls, average 47,847 tokens each, of which ~23,947 is `claude -p` boot tax (system prompt + tool definitions re-sent every call) and only 1,706 is generated output. 96% of every call was the machine loading itself; 3.6% was thinking. He is spending the next two days studying in Claude Code while the rolling window decays (5 Aug -> 54.6%, 6 Aug -> 43.7%, 7 Aug -> the 24-lakh 31 Jul day falls out). WHAT STILL RUNS: everything deterministic — capture, fsrs, calibration, nemesis, learning_state, presence, thalamus, distiller, the wall, the Goalkeeper's Oura pull. The organism keeps RECORDING while it stops THINKING, so the pause ends with real data instead of a blank week. UN-PAUSE: set false. Nothing else here changes. || UN-PAUSED 6 Aug 2026 by the captain, after the BOOT TAX was closed in brain.mjs claudeExec (--system-prompt + --tools "" + --strict-mcp-config). Measured on the same probe: 49,411 -> 5,663 tokens per call, 88.5% off. The pause existed because 96% of every call was the CLI loading itself; that is now ~5k of overhead instead of ~44k. Revert the optimisation with budget.lean_calls=false; re-pause with paused=true.

budget._unit_change_2026_08_12: C1. THESE TWO NUMBERS CHANGED UNIT, NOT JUST VALUE — they are now COST-WEIGHTED tokens (brain.mjs SPEND_WEIGHTS: input 1 · cache_write 1.25 · cache_read 0.1 · output 5), because windowUsage stopped summing raw total_tokens the same day. Comparing them against a raw token count is meaningless; read brain.mjs's SPEND comment first. WHY 2,750,000: it is MEASURED, not chosen. The one genuine account wall with usable data is 2026-08-07T19:16:26Z ('You've hit your session limit · resets 1:30am'). At that instant the organism's own 5h window measured 27,83,040 cost-weighted (83,92,039 as a raw 4-component sum; just 3,76,992 as-written) — floored to the nearest 50k. THAT AS-WRITTEN NUMBER IS WHY SELF-TUNE NEVER LEARNED: blendCeiling observed 3.77 lakh at the exact moment the account said no, floored at the then-8-lakh estimate, and concluded nothing. The estimate is deliberately NOT scaled up for the 9 Aug 20x split that doubled this share, because blendCeiling floors at the estimate and can only ever RAISE it — an over-set estimate is unrecoverable, an under-set one self-corrects on the next real wall. Weekly preserves the 15× window ratio this config has always carried (24M/1.6M = 15).
budget._note: Anthropic publishes no exact Max token caps, so these start as estimates and SELF-TUNE: any observed limit event records the true ceiling into brain_queue.json (observed_window_ceiling) and the runtime re-fits. The ledger learns the plan's real shape instead of pretending to know it.

Overshoot self-corrects: a limit event still re-fits observed_window_ceiling, and that learned value only ever RAISES the cap (brain.mjs cap0 = max(est, observed)), so until the next limit event the estimate IS the working cap. Named side effect: the pulse's daily token authorisation derives from weekly×0.10 and doubles with this — pulse stays enabled:false, so nothing spends it today. limits.mjs BUDGETS registry rows updated in the same commit (that registry rotted silently once already — its own note says so).

The split: Nidhi 800k/12M + his study 800k/12M + THE ORGANISM 1.6M/24M — zero remainder. window_capacity_est and weekly_capacity_est above ARE the organism share, exactly; they are a SHARE of one account, so any lane hitting the account wall is evidence about the shared ceiling (G2 reads limit rows account-wide).

pulse._measurement_window_note: AUDIT #66/#67 (2 Aug 2026). These two keys are a MEASUREMENT WINDOW, not a guessed cap — the captain's standing order forbids setting a numerical limit by guessing. The arithmetic, written down so the next value comes off the ledger and not off a hunch: weekly plan 12,000,000 tok × 0.10 = 1,200,000 tok/day ÷ the MEASURED 32,480 tok/pulse (853 ledger rows; ~31,970 of it the `claude -p` boot tax, ~510 the pulse's own payload) ≈ 36 pulses/day of real observation. daily_token_frac was DOUBLED from 0.05 (window opened) and every_n_beats HALVES the frequency: the pulse used to fire on every ~75s daemon beat, so it rode the stream a pulse a minute and a quarter and became 27,62,471 tok = 32.4% of the rolling week. The afferent tail moves far slower than 75 seconds, so wider spacing loses observations, not signal. daily_cap (200 calls) is untouched and is NOT a budget — it is a runaway-loop backstop, one of the two permitted exceptions (a failure guard); at this window it can never bind (1,200,000/32,480 ≈ 36). `brain status` now prints the measured tok/pulse beside the window, and reports 0 pulses as NOT MEASURED YET rather than as a mean of zero.
pulse._note: PAUSED by the captain 2 Aug 2026, and this is the first day the switch could even be honoured — brain.mjs's loadConfig returned a hardcoded key literal, so a `pulse` block was parsed and silently dropped and `enabled:false` was literally unreachable code (fixed 1 Aug). WHY PAUSED, measured not assumed: haiku_pulse is 27,62,471 tokens = 32.4% of the organism's rolling-7d spend, the single largest consumer of a 12M/week plan. It is NOT paused for being wasteful by nature — it is paused because its verdict currently reaches nobody: thalamus.mjs has zero handling for modality 'pulse', so all 124 escalations scored a ceiling of 0.244 against a 0.40-0.85 wake bar, and 853 calls have produced 0 tier-2 wakes. Paying 32% of the plan for an opinion nothing can act on is the wrong order of operations. UNPAUSE ONLY AFTER the nucleus wiring lands (plan group G3: a real pulse:* base_rate, stopword-filtered concept_tokens, and a weighted pulse term below self's 0.45) — then re-measure its wake rate before restoring any budget. Re-enable: set true. Nothing else here changes.

pulse._g14_unpause_note: LADDER G14 (9 Aug 2026, blanket ladder haan): UNPAUSED as a PURE INSTRUMENT. The 2-Aug pause reason (verdict reaches nobody) is closed: thalamus handles modality pulse (comps.pulse at thalamus.mjs:416), its weight is 0.00 (moves NO salience), and its first CONSUMER landed same-commit (the pre-answer gate admits comps.pulse>0). THE FIRST 10 LEDGER ROWS ARE THE METERED PROBES the G-plan demanded — post-lean cost per pulse comes off them (brain status prints it), and only AFTER that measurement does any weight get fitted (w_pulse = measured precision × 0.04971, the derived bound). Spacing is seconds-pinned (min_spacing_s 150) so the 15s pacer cannot quintuple it.

Measured: 426 calls, 10.40M tokens, 47.2% escalate, and only 8 opus wakes EVER across the whole gate. 98.4% of every call (31,970 of 32,480 tok) was claude -p CLI boot tax; the real payload was ~510 tok. _surface_law: AUDIT #63 (2 Aug 2026). EVERY job must declare `surface` — where its output actually appears — because eight-to-ten jobs were writing into brain_out dirs no line of code opened: 28,65,782 tokens all-time, ~32,73,067 of one 82,53,985-token week. midday_reread alone ate 5,60,465 of an 8,00,000-token 5h window for a file with no reader, while formation_read (the sheet, priority 100) got 1,03,010 all week. kind ∈ {code, job_input, human_file, media, sheet, none}: `code` = a .mjs opens it (cite file:line); `job_input` = another job here lists it in `inputs`; `human_file` = designed for the captain to read, nothing automated will (brain.mjs prints these by path in `brain status`, and runJob's note — which the ledger row now carries — names the surface on every run); `media` = an mp3/artifact; `sheet` = team_sheet.md. A job with no address is NOT silently blocked — the runtime reports it with a have/need counter and keeps running, because a missing config key must never be able to silence an organ. What is off is off EXPLICITLY below, with the exact re-enable condition named.
_inputs_law: AUDIT #64 (2 Aug 2026). An input may be a plain string (optional — the original shape, unchanged) or {"path": "...", "required": true}. gatherInputs used to map a missing path to null with no warning and buildAnalysisPrompt rendered the literal `null` under its own `## INPUT season.json` heading; teamtalk_am has produced the morning talk 85 times at 3-of-4 inputs absent at ~45k tok/run, reporting ok:true every time. A REQUIRED input that is absent skips the job BEFORE the spend and names the file. NO RATIO GUARD — a majority rule misses deep_reanalysis at exactly 50% and kills teamtalk_am at 75%, which currently degrades gracefully in words. Every `required: true` set below was verified PRESENT ON DISK on 2026-08-04, so this changes no behaviour today; it is a regression net, not a new gate. The genuinely-absent files (season.json, notebook.json, mutations.jsonl, post_match/, brain_out/dugout/TODAY.md) are left OPTIONAL on purpose — they arrive when /full-time, the Boot Room and the voice bridge run, and the absent count now rides every ledger row so the spend on nulls is finally visible.
